description: Your client-portal Reports & Analytics exactly as /portal/reports shows it, for the signed-in account only: key numbers (requests, orders, spend and outstanding per currency, quoted, certificates, active projects), request/project status counts, an activity time series, and a per-service breakdown. Filter by date range (30d, 90d, 12m, ytd, all or custom from/to), service and project. Money is reported per currency (currencies are not mixed);services without prices return null amounts (not zero). Sections report their own errors; a filter that does not apply to a section is listed in ignored_filters and that section's numbers are omitted, not shown unfiltered.

locale.description: Language of project titles. Default en.

project.description: One of your project codes (see portal_reports_options).

range.description: Date preset. Default 90d. custom needs from and to.

to.description: End day, inclusive (custom range). At most 731 days.

name: portal_reports_get
title: Reports and analytics
